items.summary: Let $Γ<\operatorname{PSL}_2(\mathbb R)$ be a torsion-free, non-elementary, finitely generated Fuchsian group with parabolic elements, and let $ρ:Γ\to G$ be a type-preserving, Zariski dense, positive representation into a connected split semisimple real algebraic group. items.title: Postcritically finite endomorphisms II: Fatou sets
items.summary: Let $f$ be a postcritically finite endomorphism of the complex projective space $\mathbb{P}^N$ of degree at least two. We prove that every Fatou component of $f$ is preperiodic to the basin of a superattracting periodic orbit.

items.title: Hyperplane winning for bad in manifolds
items.summary: We prove the hyperplane winning property of weighted badly approximable vectors inside nondegenerate analytic manifolds and affine subspaces satisfying almost optimal Diophantine conditions. items.summary: Let $f:\mathbb{P}^N\to\mathbb{P}^N$ be a postcritically finite endomorphism of degree at least two. items.summary: We introduce positively transverse reaction networks and show that, with mass-action kinetics, no bounded trajectory with positive initial condition has a boundary omega-limit point. These networks are characterized by a geometric property of a collection of polytopes defined by a subset of complexes of the network.

items.summary: In this paper, we study $r$-neutralized Pfister--Sullivan entropy, defined by measuring the complexity of orbit segments whose empirical measures lie near a prescribed invariant measure. items.summary: We develop a theory of bi-contact plugs in dimension three to construct Anosov flows or, more generally, structurally stable nonsingular flows. items.summary: We study algebraic vector bundles on cluster varieties. items.title: The moduli space of curves of genus 16 is uniruled
items.summary: Using in a novel way non-abelian Brill-Noether theory, we show that the moduli space of curves of genus 16 is uniruled. This is the highest genus for which such a result is known.

items.summary: We prove asymptotic formulas for the number of $m$-full ideals of bounded norm in a given ideal class and for the number of $m$-full algebraic integers of bounded Weil height.
